meta.title: Irreplaceable · Afraid AI will replace you? Become irreplaceable
meta.description: Your job, task by task: what AI already does, what stays yours, and ten-minute daily reps built from your own work.
meta.ogAlt: Afraid AI will replace you? Become irreplaceable. The week of a registered nurse, task by task.

hero.title: Afraid AI will replace you? Become irreplaceable
hero.lead: Upload your resume. See which tasks of your week AI already does, get a step-by-step plan, and train the part of your job only you can do.

steps.title: How it works

one.title: Tell us your job
one.body: Type your job title or drop your resume. No sign-up.

two.title: See your week
two.body: In about two minutes you see what AI already touches and what stays yours.

three.title: Train ten minutes a day
three.body: Short reps made from your own tasks. You stay the one who checks AI.

steps.lead: From your job title to your first rep in a few minutes.

features.title: What you get

map.title: Your week map
map.body: Every task of your week, sorted into what AI already does, what it speeds up and what stays yours.
map.caption: A nurse's week, mapped from a sample resume
map.top: Where most of the week goes

reps.title: Daily reps from your own work
reps.body: Ten minutes a day. Each rep is written from one of your tasks and checked right away.
reps.slipBody: AI wrote a document from your job. Find what it got wrong.
reps.delegateBody: Tell AI exactly what to do, and catch the traps before it does.
reps.edgeBody: Practice the part AI can't do: a real person who needs your answer.

game.title: AI or me?
game.body: A free daily game. Guess which of your tasks AI is already used for.

shop.title: Points you can spend
shop.body: Everything you do earns points. Spend them on Pro discounts and free months.

proof.title: Proof for your next review
proof.body: Every finished rep is saved as proof you can bring to your manager.

streak.title: Your streak
streak.body: Practice a little every day and watch the week fill up.

features.lead: One place to see where you stand and to get a little sharper every day.

data.title: Built on real data
data.lead: Your week map is not a guess. It is put together from three public sources.

onet.name: O*NET
onet.body: The tasks your job is made of.

aei.name: Anthropic Economic Index
aei.body: What people already use AI for at work.

closing.title: Find out what makes you irreplaceable
closing.lead: Type your job title. Your week map takes about two minutes.

footer.slogan: Stay irreplaceable as AI changes your work.

pay.title: What you pay for
pay.lead: Your week map is free. Pay only when you want daily practice.

banner.title: Your first rep: find the mistake AI made in your top task
banner.body: It is free, takes a few minutes and is written from your own work.
